description: Opens an access for a colleague without a password: an invitation goes to send_to, and whoever opens it chooses the password from its link, which opens for seven days and once. The link is never shown here, you included, and the record names where it went. send_to is the person themselves at an address they already read, or the box of whoever sets up the team's access. A mailbox of this platform is accepted only when an active person already signs in to it; one nobody can open yet, such as the new login itself, is refused, and so is a support queue. Called again for somebody who has not answered yet, it sends a new invitation and the previous link stops opening; somebody who already chose a password is refused, as they change it themselves. Only on an account that is not held at the shop, and never above manager.

email.description: The address the person will sign in with, for example their new mailbox "zoe@sonentreprise.com".

locale.description: The language of the invitation and of their screens.

name.description: Their name, as the team will read it. Required for somebody new.

role.description: Operator by default: they see the queues and boxes they are given. A manager sees every queue and runs the settings.

send_to.description: Where the invitation goes: an address the person already reads, or the box of whoever sets up the team's access, for example "it@sonentreprise.com". A box of this platform nobody signs in to yet is refused.

name: invite_person
title: Invite someone to the account
